en: Colorized scenic view over a European city with red-tiled roofs and a river running through the center, crossed by several bridges. The image is taken from an elevated vantage point with trees and a wooden railing in the foreground. At the lower left, an illustrated girl in traditional dress holds a large bouquet of yellow flowers. In the distance, church towers and dense urban buildings stretch across a flat plain. In the top right corner, printed text reads "Graz vom Schlossberg."
